## Purpose

What the change does and why. Reference the issue with `Refs #N`.

## Screenshots

For a change the user can see: before and after, on iOS and on macOS when both change. Write "none" otherwise.

## Validation

The tests that were run and where, for example `swift test --package-path PrestoCVCore`, `Tools/ArchitectureCheck/check.sh` and `Tools/DocsCheck/check.sh`, and the simulator and OS version for the app tests. Flag any flakiness or simulator prerequisite.

## Localization

Whether the change adds or changes a user-facing string, and in which languages it is translated. Write "none" otherwise.

## Documents updated

Which documents does this change update, so that they still describe the code? List them, for example `docs/architecture/modules.md` or a README. If no document needs to change, say why.
